_meta.fieldConvention: Each figure carries value, currency, url, publisher, date, sourceType ('primary'|'secondary'), confirmed (true only when the figure was read on the cited page or document during this research). null means no published figure was found; nothing was estimated or invented.
notes: US state motorcycle averages are ValuePenguin's modeled quote averages for one rider profile (45-year-old single man, 2018 Honda CMX500 Rebel, full coverage 50/100/25 BI/PD, UM 50/100, $5,000 MedPay, $500 deductibles). They are quote samples, not market-wide averages of premiums actually paid.
UK figures are comparison-site medians of premiums paid by their own customers, which skew toward shoppers.

BC figures are computed from ICBC's Basic Insurance Tariff (primary, BCUC/Registrar-filed): base rate $903.55 x rate-class-and-territory factor for Territory D (Lower Mainland), at the $200,000 third-party liability limit. This is the Basic (compulsory) base-rate premium before the driver factor (DF), claims/discount factors, optional coverage and taxes, so it is not what an individual pays.
Ireland, Ontario and Canada-wide RV figures are broker/aggregator ranges, not averages computed from data; they are marked secondary and should be treated as estimates.

newYork.note: The page states the monthly figure; the annual value is monthly x 12.

englandUK.note: UK-wide, not England-only. No ABI average for motorcycles was found.

ireland.note: No published average from an Irish broker or the Central Bank's National Claims Information Database was found; NCID's private motor reporting covers cars. These are ranges from quote samples, not an average.

310.description: limited speed motorcycle (<=50cc or <=1.5 kW, <=70 km/h) and motorcycles 110cc or less

britishColumbia.publisher: Insurance Corporation of British Columbia, Basic Insurance Tariff (Schedule B Table 4.14-A; Schedule C p.2, Twenty-First Revision effective 2026-09-01)
britishColumbia.note: Values are computed here as base rate x factor; the factors and base rate were read in the tariff. The rate-class-to-displacement mapping was read from a PDF text extraction whose table columns were misaligned; it agrees with the widely reported 311 = 111-400cc etc. Other territories differ (e.g., Territory P Cariboo: 310 $365.94, 311 $519.54, 312 $883.67, 313 $967.70, 314 $1,320.09). The 'base rate means $903.55' definition sits on a page marked Fourteenth Revision effective 2024-01-01 and was not superseded in the current consolidation.

newYork.insuranceRequired: Liability insurance required to operate anywhere in NY except the owner's own property.
newYork.note: The brief's '$10?' is superseded: the DMV page says $12.50/yr plus a $12.50 plate fee.

connecticut.registrationRequired: Yes, except when operated on premises owned or leased by the owner.

fees.term: not stated on the fee page

connecticut.note: Registration is with DMV, not DEEP. DEEP governs where ATVs may ride (state lands largely closed; https://portal.ct.gov/deep/outdoor-recreation/atv-policy). Whether liability insurance is required is contradictory across secondary sources; left null.

california.registrationRequired: OHV identification plate (green sticker if CARB-compliant, red sticker otherwise) for off-highway use
california.note: Fee funds the OHMVR Division/OHV Trust Fund. No state insurance mandate for off-highway use was found.

englandUK.offRoad: No licence, registration or tax needed for off-road use; an optional DVLA off-road register exists (INF85).
englandUK.onRoad: Must be road-legal (type-approved), registered with DVLA with front and rear plates, taxed, MOT after 3 years, third-party insurance, full car (B) licence or pre-1997 B1.
englandUK.agricultural: Registered as a light agricultural vehicle; no vehicle tax, no MOT, but registration, plate and third-party insurance needed for road use.
englandUK.note: Most quads sold are not road-legal. A road-use quad's tax class/rate (limited use or PLG) was not quoted on the page.

ireland.offRoad: Farm-only use off public roads needs no tax or insurance (secondary).
ireland.onRoad: Must be registered with Revenue, taxed, insured, plated; full B licence to drive on a public road. A quad cannot be taxed at the motorcycle rate: with a tow bar it is taxed as a general haulage tractor, without one as a private vehicle by engine cc.
ireland.trainingRequirement: Compulsory quad training course since November 2023 (secondary: southernstar.ie).

fee.what: off-road vehicle permit and number plate (one-time)

ontario.insuranceRequired: Must be insured under a motor vehicle liability policy (and plated) except on land occupied by the owner and in exempt far-northern areas.
ontario.note: Minimum $200,000 third-party liability is widely stated by brokers; not confirmed on the government page.

fee.what: Certificate of Registration plus ICBC-issued number plate or sticker (one-time)

britishColumbia.insuranceRequired: Not required for off-road use on the registration page; on-highway use (e.g., crossing a road) requires ICBC Basic under rate class 036.

onHighwayBasicPremium.measure: ICBC rate class 036 (ATV, other use), Territory D, $200K, base rate $903.55 x 0.065, before driver factor

mexicoCity.note: No published rule or fee found.

motorcycle12Month.date: read 2026-09-30; effective date not shown on page
motorcycle12Month.note: The brief's figures are confirmed as current. Zero-emission bikes are listed at the same GBP 27 as up-to-150cc bikes (consistent with the end of the electric-vehicle exemption on 2025-04-01, which was not itself read on this page).

annualPlateRenewal.note: Plate-sticker renewal fees for motorcycles and mopeds were cut to $0 on 2022-03-13 (previously $42 southern / $21 northern Ontario). Renewal is automatic and free where the vehicle is insured and has no unpaid fines or tolls; it still has to be valid each year.

newRegistration.note: The exact standard motorcycle plate fee is not itemized on the page.

formerValidationFee.note: Historic southern-Ontario figure, no longer charged; stated in secondary sources (OFA, Global News).

annualLicenceFee.publisher: BC Laws, Motor Vehicle Fees Regulation (B.C. Reg. 334/91)
annualLicenceFee.note: Confirmed. Collector/antique motorcycles $35. Motor homes $63-$125 by weight; trailers $23-$99 by GVW.

newYork.rule: Class 1 and 2 (20 mph) statewide; Class 3 (25 mph) only in cities of 1M+ (NYC). E-bikes cannot be registered with DMV; no licence, registration or insurance. Faster devices are e-motos/mopeds/motorcycles subject to DMV registration, licensing and insurance. NYC DOT sets a 15 mph limit on city streets for e-bikes.
newYork.note: Read via search-result extract of the DMV page, not fetched directly. Bills to require e-bike registration/insurance/licensing (e.g., S2599A/A339A 'Priscilla's Law' for NYC plates) were proposed, not enacted, as of this research.

connecticut.rule: E-bike = operable pedals, motor under 750 W, Class 1/2 (20 mph) or 3 (28 mph). Not registered with DMV, no driver's licence. Since 2025-10-01 (HB 6862): all e-bike riders must wear a helmet; pedal-less electric bikes over 750 W are motor-driven cycles (driver's licence required); over 3,500 W are motorcycles (registration and insurance).
connecticut.publisher: Connecticut General Assembly, Office of Legislative Research (2024-R-0154)
connecticut.note: The 2025 changes come from secondary reporting (CT Mirror, NBC Connecticut, Daily Campus), not confirmed on a statute page. Municipalities may require annual bicycle/e-bike licensing (OLR report).

california.rule: Class 1/2 (20 mph) and Class 3 (28 mph), motor under 750 W. 'A person operating an electric bicycle is not subject to the provisions of this code relating to financial responsibility, driver's licenses, registration, and license plate requirements.'

englandUK.rule: EAPC: continuous rated power no more than 250 W; no assistance above 15.5 mph; rider 14+. 'You do not need a licence to ride an EAPC and it does not need to be registered, taxed or insured.'

ireland.rule: Since 2024-05-20 (Road Traffic and Roads Act 2023): pedelecs with max 250 W that cut off at 25 km/h and when pedaling stops are bicycles; no licence, registration, tax or insurance. Faster, more powerful or throttle-only bikes are e-mopeds requiring licence, registration, tax and insurance.
ireland.note: Page returned 403 to direct fetch; content read via search-result extract and corroborated by irishcycle.com.

ontario.rule: Motor max 500 W, assisted speed max 32 km/h, max weight 120 kg, rider 16+, approved helmet. E-bikes are treated as bicycles: no licence, insurance or registration, unless the pedals are removed (then a motor vehicle).

britishColumbia.rule: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation (in force 2024-04-05): standard e-bikes 500 W / 32 km/h, rider 16+, throttle allowed; light e-bikes 250 W / 25 km/h, no throttle, rider 14+. Helmet required. 'You do not need a driver's license or insurance to operate an e-bike in B.C.'

mexicoCity.rule: Pedal-assist e-bikes under 250 W with a 25 km/h maximum are exempt from plates and licence, but from 2026-07-01 must carry a free official Semovi hologram marking them exempt. Anything over 250 W (up to 1 kW) or over 25 km/h is a VEMEPE/VEP needing a plate, circulation card and licence.

exemptHologramCost.note: Reported as free by Infobae; not confirmed on a Semovi page.

plate.note: Reduced from an originally announced MXN 709/710.

aboveThresholdCosts.deadline: Vehicles bought before 2026-07-01 must be registered by 2026-11-20; sanctions from 2026-11-20.

mexicoCity.publisher: Infobae México; Eje Central (reporting Semovi / Gaceta Oficial reform of the Reglamento de Tránsito)
mexicoCity.note: Not a 'requires nothing' market as of July 2026. Gaceta Oficial publication itself was not read. Earlier Infobae (May) said penalties for new vehicles began 2026-09-01; Eje Central (Sept 1) says sanctions start 2026-11-20.

motorcycleHelmet.note: Retail listing price by color/size; an entry-level helmet, not an average.

uncertain: ICBC rate-class mapping (310 = limited speed motorcycle and <=110cc; 311 = 111-400cc; 312 = 401-750cc; 313 = 751-1150cc; 314 = over 1150cc) was reconstructed from a column-misaligned PDF text extraction; it matches rider-forum reporting.
ICBC figures are base-rate premiums before the driver factor, so an experienced rider's discount (up to ~40%+) or a new rider's surcharge will move the real bill substantially.
US state motorcycle figures are one-profile quote samples; NY ($27/mo) coming in below the national average ($33/mo) reflects that profile, not all NY riders.
Ireland and Ontario motorcycle figures are ranges with no stated methodology; no data-based average was found for either.
Ontario and BC RV/trailer ranges were read only in search-result extracts (confirmed: false).
Progressive's RV averages are 2024 data (page dated 2024-11-14); no newer insurer-published figure found.
UK caravan medians are September 2024 data on a page dated 2024; no 2026 update found.
Connecticut ATV insurance requirement is contradictory across secondary sources; the CT DMV fee page does not give the registration term.
New York e-bike rule and Ireland e-bike rule were read via search extracts of the government pages (direct fetch failed).
Connecticut's 2025 e-bike changes (HB 6862, effective 2025-10-01) come from news reporting, not the statute text.
Mexico City e-bike/VEMEPE costs are from news reports of Semovi's announcements, not the Gaceta Oficial; the date sanctions start differs between reports.
No motorcycle, scooter, RV or ATV insurance average was found for Mexico City beyond the caller's existing motorcycle range; ATV rules in CDMX were not found.
